brief:
The Freedom Flotilla is preparing to embark on a new international maritime operation to Gaza, according to Ma'an Wire. The initiative aims to deliver humanitarian supplies to the blockaded coastal territory and challenge restrictions on sea access to the Palestinian enclave.

The flotilla has previously attempted similar voyages to breach Gaza's maritime blockade, drawing international participation and media attention. Organizers are currently finalizing logistical arrangements for the planned mission. The specific timing of departure, list of participating vessels, cargo manifesto, and other operational details have not yet been disclosed as preparations continue.
title: Freedom Flotilla prepares new sailing mission to Gaza
